title: Arrow functions se calculation
solution:
const double = (x) => x * 2
const isEven = (n) => n % 2 === 0
const square = (x) => x * x

console.log(double(5))
console.log(isEven(4))
console.log(square(6))
hints: Single expression mein return keyword zaroori nahi
n % 2 === 0 se check hota hai even
